style_anchor: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, restrained chiaroscuro, slice-of-life interior drama, naturalistic character proportions, muted warm-cool palette

expression_signature.eyes: narrowed to slits, sharp focus on the offender, the upper lid pulled down hard to half-cover the iris
expression_signature.brows: drawn down and inward at the bridge, forming a clear frown — less extreme than '愤怒', no V-shape, just a settled scowl
expression_signature.mouth: closed, lips pressed hard together so the lip color goes pale in the middle, corners pulled slightly downward, jaw visibly clenched
expression_signature.cheeks: slight flush, not the deep red of rage
expression_signature.head: tilted slightly forward and to the right by 5-10 degrees — the classic 'I'm giving you one chance' head tilt
expression_signature.overall_impression: the everyday scolding face — used heavily across Page 2-6 (morning wake-up sequence) and Page 12 (homecoming), this is her default 'mode' for most of the story

inherit_from_base.wardrobe_default: as in base-v1 — fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top + light grey high-waisted yoga leggings
inherit_from_base.default_posture_override: one hand on hip, the other hand pointing or holding a phone / toothbrush / doorframe

micro_motion.static: standing in doorway or by sofa, weight on front foot, ready to advance or retreat
micro_motion.subtle_motion: nostrils flare once at the start of a sentence; head shake of two sharp ticks during '你跟我说话什么态度'; one hand pointing finger taps the air twice for emphasis

lighting_preference_for_this_expression.preferred: harsh morning sun behind her from hallway, backlit hair rim light, face partially in shadow — intimidating doorway silhouette
lighting_preference_for_this_expression.avoid: flat frontal lighting — would soften the scowl

voice_lines_examples: 我跟你说话你当没听见是吧
什么态度啊，你凶我干嘛呀
